_readme: Waivers for scripts/visual-gate.mjs. A check named here may fail without failing the gate, because it describes a defect a later story owns. The ratchet turns one way only: when a waived check starts passing, the gate FAILS until its entry is deleted here. Adding an entry is how you record a known defect; deleting one is part of the story that fixes it. Never add an entry to get a run green.

character-select-reachable.what: Story 12.4 registers the /select route and gives it a real screen, so a visitor reaches a page rather than a blank viewport -- but the screen is a placeholder that names no fighters. render/roster.ts still freezes DEFAULT_ROSTER to ['clawde','chatty']; gemini and grokk ship full sprite packs and portraits that nothing can select.
character-select-reachable.clears_when: The screen shown at #/select names all four fighters (clawde, chatty, gemini, grokk) and a visitor can pick between them.
